name: Bankruptcy filings by chapter, court district, state and county, quarterly (U.S. Courts)
description: Bankruptcy cases commenced in the 12 months ending on each quarter-end, from the U.S. Courts' Tables F-5A (by county and chapter), F-2 (by court district, chapter and business or nonbusiness debt) and F (cases filed, terminated and pending). One record per area: the United States, every state, DC and territory, 93 court districts and about 3,100 counties. Each gives the latest period's cases by Chapter 7, 11, 13 and other chapters, the business and nonbusiness split, the change on the year before, filings per 1,000 residents (Census 2025 population estimates) and the court's figures for the six earlier periods. Every table is checked against the court's own totals row. Counts of cases, not outcomes: a filing is not a discharge.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Bankruptcy filings by chapter, court district, state and county, quarterly (U.S. Courts) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23962892

distribution.name: bankruptcy.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: bankruptcy.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: bankruptcy-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in bankruptcy-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to bankruptcy.csv on id.

recordSet.name: bankruptcy
recordSet.description: The records of Bankruptcy filings by chapter, court district, state and county, quarterly (U.S. Courts), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: area
field.description: US, a 2-digit state FIPS code, a court district such as CA-C (the state, then N, S, E, W, M or C; a state with one district is just the state code) or a 5-digit county FIPS code

field.name: areaName
field.description: The area's name; counties end with their state code

field.name: areaType
field.description: us, state, district or county

field.name: period
field.description: The 12 months end on this date (YYYY-MM-DD); the window starts on the first day of the 12th month before

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The machine value (see unit)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: filings
field.description: Bankruptcy cases commenced in the 12 months, all chapters

field.name: ch7
field.description: Chapter 7 cases commenced

field.name: ch11
field.description: Chapter 11 cases commenced

field.name: ch13
field.description: Chapter 13 cases commenced

field.name: other
field.description: Chapters 9, 12 and 15 and Section 304 cases commenced

field.name: business
field.description: Cases where the court classed the debt as predominantly business

field.name: nonbusiness
field.description: Cases where the court classed the debt as nonbusiness, mostly consumer debt

field.name: ch7Share
field.description: Chapter 7 cases as a percent of all cases

field.name: ch13Share
field.description: Chapter 13 cases as a percent of all cases

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
